declared_by: owner requirement 2026-10-25 (one canonical production promotion gate)
declaration_note: Every value below was fixed BEFORE any candidate was scored under this gate. Most of them are values this estate had already declared before 2026-10-25 (see 'provenance'), reused rather than re-chosen so they cannot have been tuned on the candidates they now judge. Changing any value is a new gate_version and an architecture change that needs owner approval. Justification for each value is in src/promotion_gate.py.

tracks.rule: config.model_type_for_league(league) -> standard | new_format | unknown. Every criterion is computed per track; tracks are never pooled. A track below min_n_per_track is reported and excluded; at least one track must be evaluable and every evaluable track must pass.

provenance.min_n_per_track_holdout: MIN_N = 1000 in src/champion_gate.py (2026-10-18) and src/promotion_gate.py (2026-10-01); GATE.min_rows_holdout = 1000 in Pro src/models/registry.py
provenance.sd_ratio / max_frac_moved: spread x1.5 and >25% moved >10pp, pipeline._behaviour_canary, set from the 2026-09-23 incident
provenance.prospective min_n_per_track: n_min_per_track = 1000, models/registry/experiments.json, owner decision 2026-10-25 for H-MODEL-01
provenance.bootstrap_unit: match-date blocks, as src/shadow_experiments.evaluate and Pro src/analytics/model_lineage._day_boot_ci already use
provenance.new in PG-1.0: max_mean_shift, max_quantile_shift, extreme share, slope check, early_fail_min_n, max_age_days, min_bootstrap_blocks

props.declared_by: owner decision 2026-10-25 ('yes'): player-prop models promote only through the canonical promotion gate, like the team models
props.declaration_note: Same two-period gate as PG-1.0, applied PER MARKET instead of per track (markets are never pooled). Declared before any props candidate was scored on a same-holdout basis. Probability-scale thresholds are the PG-1.0 values rescaled by fixed factors derived from each market's LABEL base rate in player_history.parquet as of 2026-10-25 (870,856 rows) - labels only, no model output. Changing any value is a new gate_version and needs owner approval. Justifications: player_model/props_gate.py.

scaling_rule.entropy_ratio: H(base_rate)/ln 2 - scales log-loss quantities (material floor, league regression)
scaling_rule.prob_scale: base_rate/0.5 - scales probability-unit quantities (ECE, mean shift, quantile shift, moved_pp)

provenance.unchanged from PG-1.0: match-date block bootstrap (2000 draws, seed, 95%, >=20 dates), ECE bins, slope check (0.25 and 2 SE), sd-ratio band, max_frac_moved 0.25, extreme-share increase 0.02, min_league_n 150, early_fail_min_n 300, max_age_days 180, prospective sign rule (delta < 0), min_n 1000 in both periods
provenance.rescaled from PG-1.0 by the market's bas: material_ll_improvement (0.001), max_brier_worsening (0.0001), max_ece_worsening (0.01), max_league_ll_regression (0.02), max_mean_shift (0.02), max_quantile_shift (0.05), moved_pp (0.10)
provenance.new in PG-PROPS-1.0: min_events_per_market 100 (both periods) and min_league_events 30; extreme_lo 0.001 (the props Platt clip floor) in place of 0.05; a holdout overlapping a KNOWN champion training cutoff is trimmed to the days strictly after it (PG-1.0 fails the comparison instead)
provenance.base rates: player_history.parquet as of commit acc2ec4b (2026-10-25), all labelled rows per target
